messages:
emily: Heads-up — invoice preview showing ~2.3k tokens attributed to route alias `beta-ui` for tenant `acme-inc` even though sampling=0 and no recent traffic from them.
sam: hmm. did the tenant recently switch to a dedicated route? any route-mapping changes in the last 24h?
emily: not on our change log. they said they only rerouted in the app to `preview` local flag. ui shows no calls. preview pipeline shows an event for beta-ui at 2026-03-19T18:01Z.
naveen: can you paste the raw event? maybe it's a preview-mode synthetic that slipped into billing stream.
emily: sure — copy paste from preview logs:
```
{"ts":"2026-03-19T18:01:12Z","tenant":"acme-inc","route":"beta-ui","sampling":0,"tokens":2345,"source":"preview-fanout","fingerprint":"fp_9a3c"}
```
lucy: wow sampling=0 but tokens present. preview-fanout should be filtered before metering. billing-ingest has filter:
```
if event.source == "preview-fanout": drop
```
maybe the field name changed? preview->preview-fanout mismatch?
sam: check the metering-proxy mapping — we recently merged the route alias normalization patch (PR #4221). It added alias -> canonical mapping but also added fallback tags for unknown aliases.
naveen: that PR added `fallback_route: "_alias_shadow"` for unmatched alias lookups. If preview-fanout delivered alias and alias->canonical failed, fallback could have set a real route and allowed it through.
emily: so the flow might be: preview-fanout event arrives with route alias, alias normalization fails (maybe TTL), proxy sets fallback_route, then downstream filter checks source=="preview" (not preview-fanout) and lets it through. 
lucy: can we grep for other events with source containing "preview" variants? I'll run a quick query.
lucy: quick check shows ~120 events in last 48h with source values: ["preview","preview-fanout","preview-v2","preview-fanout-us"]. Our filter only checks for exact string.
sam: great catch. two issues: 1) alias fallback making events look routable; 2) brittle source filtering. fixable.
emily: what's priority? this affects invoice previews for several tenants.
sam: P0 for a hotfix to metering-ingest: change the preview filter to substring match /preview/ and remove fallback_route insertion for events where source startswith preview.
naveen: I'll open a quick patch. proposed change:
```
- if event.source == "preview-fanout": drop
+ if "preview" in event.source: drop
+ if event.source.startswith("preview"): event.pop("fallback_route", None)
```
lucy: also add a small audit metric: increment `metering.preview_dropped` when we drop by preview filter, to ensure visibility.
emily: can we backfill/remove the bad events from the current invoice preview dataset? they come from the streaming buffer (kafka topic `billing-ingest`) — we can run a tombstone/compaction job for those keys or re-run preview job excluding preview* sources.
sam: easiest: re-run invoice-preview job with a new flag `--exclude-source-pattern=preview` for the last 48h. that will generate a corrected preview for affected tenants.
naveen: patch PR opened: https://git.redwood/redwood/metering/patches/PR-4982 (small change + metric). I'll canary to staging now.
metering-bot: deploy started: metering-ingest v1.18.3-canary -> staging at 2026-03-19T19:02Z :rocket:
sam: after canary, let's watch `metering.preview_dropped` and `billing.preview_invoices.delta` dashboards.
lucy: also add a small alert: if preview_dropped spikes > 10/min, fail the canary (likely misclassification) — otherwise looks safe.
emily: thanks team — will notify support and update affected tenant previews once staging looks good.
sam: follow-up action: create an integration test asserting any event with source matching /preview/ is ignored by billing pipeline. assign to naveen.
naveen: assigned. ETA end of day.
emily: great. closing out here unless anyone sees other fallout. :thumbsup:
